about: Quests, achievements, titles and stamps (docs/design/03-domain-model.md, Quest). Shared by the server (server/internal/quest runs them) and the game (src/game/quests.ts shows them). A quest starts by itself once it is available: the character has one of tags_any (archetypes.json) and has completed every quest in requires. flow: sequence (objectives in order), all, or any. An objective's type is one of the objective types in server/internal/quest/objective (each checks its params); count is how many times it must happen (distinct places, NPCs or players where that makes sense; seconds for stay_place, metres for ride_distance). at is where the tracker points: a place or an NPC id. Rewards: titles, stamps, a capability, xu. repeat: "daily" starts a quest over every day (Saigon time); dailies in one pool take turns, one a day (picked by the date), and a daily without a pool runs every day. Dailies give xu and stamps, never titles or capabilities. Stamps in the set "streak" are for days of dailies in a row (daily_streak). An achievement is a passive quest with one objective, open to everyone with one of its tags (or everyone without tags). Ids are stable: progress is stored by quest and objective id, so rename text freely but never an id.
